entities.summary: John Bourchier, 2nd Baron Berners was an English soldier, statesman, and translator who played a significant role in the political landscape of 16th-century England. Born in unknown circumstances, Bourchier rose to prominence through his military service and later became a key figure in the establishment of the Church of England. His translations of classical texts helped shape the English language and literature. Bourchier's legacy can be seen in the continued influence of the Church of England and the English language on global culture. The legacy of John Bourchier, 2nd Baron Berners, is a testament to the enduring impact of a single individual on the course of history.
